name: XPT Reader
description: Reads a SAS transport file (XPORT version 5, .xpt): one dataset as records, plus a list of the datasets in the file and their fields.
introductoryText:
Reads a SAS transport file (`.xpt`, XPORT version 5, the format used for clinical trial submissions) from a folder on the Omniscope server.

**How to set it up**: choose the file and, if it holds several datasets, the dataset to read (empty reads the first).

**Outputs**: *Dataset* has the records of the chosen dataset; *Summary* lists every dataset in the file with its label and record count; *Fields* lists every field with its SAS label, type, length and format. Numbers with a SAS date or datetime format (such as `DATE9.` or `E8601DT.`) become dates unless you untick *Read SAS dates as dates*.

options.name: xptFile
options.title: XPT file
options.description: The SAS transport file (.xpt) on the Omniscope server.

options.name: datasetName
options.title: Dataset to read
options.description: The dataset's name in the file, such as ADSL (upper or lower case). Empty: the first dataset. The Summary output lists the names.

options.name: convertDates
options.title: Read SAS dates as dates
options.description: Ticked: numbers with a SAS date format (DATE9., YYMMDD10. and the like) or datetime format (DATETIME20., E8601DT.) become Date fields. Unticked: they stay as SAS numbers (days or seconds since 1 January 1960).

blockOutputs.label: Summary
blockOutputs.tooltip: One record per dataset in the file: name, label, record count, field count, field names, and when it was created and modified.

blockOutputs.label: Dataset
blockOutputs.tooltip: The records of the chosen dataset (the first one if none is chosen).

blockOutputs.label: Fields
blockOutputs.tooltip: One record per field of every dataset: SAS name, label, type, length, format, and how the block reads it.
